Name: Cuter Water Bowls for Slime Hutch
Author: proudunicorn
Description:
UPDATE: This is now included in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6497]Slime Hutch to Menagerie[/url] mod, so you don't need to install both!

Replaces the water troughs in the slime hutch with cuter water bowls.

They work as usual.

Should work with any custom slime hutch interior.

If using the very cool "Slime Hutch Natural Interior" by wildzooey you will need to delete the towninterior.png file from their assets folder.

Should work with ATDSV as this mod should patch after ATDSV (because alphabetical) [s]but I have not tested this yet. would appreciate feedback on this! :)
[/s]Have tested and it does work :)
